site.name: AMN Healthcare
site.mechanism_justification: The site is a custom SPA (Single Page Application) for healthcare staffing. Job listings are loaded dynamically via JavaScript — the /jobs/c/{Category}/ pages return only shell HTML via direct HTTP with no job content. JS rendering is needed to get actual job data. The site uses a custom built frontend with bundled JS assets served from /dist/corp/ and has no identifiable ecommerce CMS markers.

anti_bot.details: No anti-bot protection detected. Direct HTTP access works without proxy. The site does have reCAPTCHA on its contact form but not on job pages. No Cloudflare, Akamai, or PerimeterX markers found.

connectivity.notes: Direct HTTP returns full page HTML but job listing content requires JavaScript rendering (SPA). No proxy needed. Browser-based scraping required for job detail pages.

product_discovery.url_pattern_notes: Job categories use /jobs/c/{CategoryName}/ pattern. Individual job detail URLs likely follow a pattern under /jobs/ with specific job identifiers. The site is an SPA so job URLs may use hash or query-based routing within the /jobs/ path. The scraper should navigate to provided job URLs and extract JobPosting data from the rendered DOM, including JSON-LD structured data if present.

rate_limiting.justification: Healthcare staffing site with no aggressive rate limiting detected. Conservative delay to avoid triggering any server-side protections during bulk scraping.
